Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing penalties for retail liquor licensees when alcohol is sold to a person under twenty-one years of age.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to penalties for retail liquor licensees; adding anew section to chapter 66.44 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A retail liquor licensee is subject to a penalty as follows if thelicensee or an employee of the licensee is cited by the board for saleof alcohol to a person under twenty-one years of age: (1) For a first offense, the penalty is a written warning; (2) For a second offense in a two-year period, the penalty is awritten warning and an order that the individual who made the saleattend mandatory alcohol service training; (3) For a third, fourth, or fifth offense in a two-year period, thepenalty is suspension of the liquor license or a monetary penalty, thelength of suspension and amount of the monetary penalty to increase foreach offense, as established by the board; (4) For a sixth offense in a two-year period, the penalty is p. 1 SB 5219cancellation of the liquor license.
